exposure: Novel de novo variant c.5334_5335delAG (p. Arg1778Serfs*11) in the SON gene
outcome: Delay in physical and psychomotor development
cohort: A single Chinese female patient presenting with neonatal hypotonia, severe global developmental delay, seizures, and mild facial dysmorphism.
finding: The study identified a novel de novo variant c.5334_5335delAG (p. Arg1778Serfs*11) in the SON gene, providing a definitive diagnosis for the patient's symptoms, which are consistent with Zhu-Tokita-Takenouchi-Kim syndrome (ZTTK syndrome).
